[[Category:Omega]]
Catgirls are the highest form humans can be, and the jump off point for becoming greater entities

==Physical description==
* Cat ears in addition to human ears
* Cat tail
* Reproduce with artificial uteri
* All female
** Can have either genitalia
** Can become [[catboy]]s
* Immortal
* Heightened senses
